chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding a man who had a wet dream at the beginning of the night, or had intercourse with his wife, then he slept deliberately during the month of Ramadan until morning. He said: He completes his fast for that day, then he makes it up after he breaks his fast from the month of Ramadan, and he seeks forgiveness of his Lord.
ai.seo_question: Does a wet dream or intercourse at night invalidate the Ramadan fast if one sleeps until morning?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that voluntary negligence in performing Ghusl until dawn does not invalidate the fast, distinguishing this ruling from cases where sleep prevents washing. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the obligation of Ghusl is for prayer, not for the validity of the fast itself, though repentance is required for the deliberate delay. The ruling underscores the importance of intention and the distinction between ritual purity for Salah and the state of impurity during Sawm.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdllah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding a man who bed-wets at the beginning of the night, or attains from his wife, then he sleeps deliberately during the Month of Ramazan, until the morning. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should complete that Fast of his, then he should make up for it, when he broke a Fast from the Month of Ramazan, and he should seek Forgiveness of his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who experiences a wet dream during the night in the month of Ramadan or has sexual intercourse with his wife; then goes to sleep intentionally in the month of Ramadan until the morning.
He (the Imam) said, ‘He is required to complete that fast and make its Qada’ (compensatory fast) if he invalidates the fast of the month of Ramadan. He must ask his Lord for forgiveness.’”
